# `page.reorder`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/page.reorder.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`page.reorder`: moves page records before another page of the same section, or to the section's end (FR-PAG-024,
WP-S2.06 §5.1).

The pages of the section (front matter when `before` is absent and `section` is absent or null) are ordered by
(folio number, label in natural order, ID). The moved pages, taken in that order, are put as one block directly
before `before`, or after the last page of the section when `before` is absent. The folio keys (number and label)
stay where they are in the order: the page that comes to a position takes the whole key of the page that held it,
so a moved page takes over the key of the page it replaces and the pages it passes shift by one; pages whose key
does not change get no change, and a transaction notice `<old> → <new>` names each page that moved. One undo step.
Rejected: no page or more than 1,000 pages named, a page named twice or unknown, an unknown `before` or `section`,
both `before` and `section`, a `before` that is one of the moved pages, a moved page in another section than the
target, and an order that does not change. Bulk.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `before` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) or `null` | no | `null` | The page they are put before; absent or null: after the last page of the section. |
| `pages` | array of [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The page records to move, 1 to 1,000, in any order (they are taken in page order). |
| `section` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) or `null` | no | `null` | Without `before`: the section at whose end the pages go; absent or null: front matter. Not allowed with `before`. |

## Types

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).

This is a bulk command: a log line runs it as a preview first and commits the previewed result ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)).
